headline: Professional Trainer | Public Speaker | Coach | Community Specialist & Enthusiast | 10 Years Experience | IG & Threads : @kangdimmy
summary:
Professional Profile
1. Public Speaking Trainer (2017 – 2026) With a decade of experience, I have shared my expertise in Public Speaking across various sectors, including Corporations, Government Institutions, F&B, Banking, Organizations, Schools, Universities, Islamic Boarding Schools (Pesantren), and various communities.
I have conducted training sessions in nearly 40 cities across Indonesia and I operate flexibly as a personal brand, through vendors, or as an associate for several training institutions.

2. Content Creator I actively share practical Public Speaking tips and insights through digital content on Instagram Reels and TikTok, aiming to make communication skills accessible to a wider audience.

3. Public Relations I am entrusted as the Public Relations Officer for Indonesia Speak Up, where I manage communication strategies and represent the organization’s voice.

4. Community Leader & Volunteer I serve as an advisor, board member, and volunteer for several local communities in Bandung, focusing on social impact and human resource development.
